verdict.rationale: Square supports event-driven automation mainly through developer webhooks: you subscribe to event notifications and validate them, but the actions must be built in your own code. The only user-definable rules shown are fraud-specific "custom rules and alerts" for managing payment risk. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/automation builder (if-event-then-action) for sellers, documented action types beyond fraud alerts, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the automation workflows.
